Metadata is the value: model code, version string, chipset/platform, market region
version_date is extracted from version strings where present (YYMMDD pattern) — it is a BUILD DATE, not a patch level. Do not treat as security_level.
android_version extracted from project_name 'Android NN' suffix where present
platform field contains raw MediaTek/Unisoc/Qualcomm chip identifiers with marketing names in parens
download_status='expired' on all rows — verified by API probe against fra315.api.aliyunpds.com
market_type codes: GL=Global, RU=Russia, TR=Turkey, OP=Operator, IN=India, EU=Europe, COCL=Colombia, etc.
